_comment: TOOLS = MCP servers, fed to every agent via the ACP session/new call (NOT a native config file — agents' own formats differ: .mcp.json (JSON) for Claude/Cursor vs ~/.codex/config.toml (TOML) for Codex). ACP is what unifies them. Shape is the de-facto `mcpServers` object (Claude Desktop/Code/Cursor). env values support ${VAR} expansion for API keys.

cua-driver._comment: Background macOS computer-use via accessibility tree (no cursor takeover, no focus steal). Exposes launch_app, list_apps, get_window_state, click, type_text, press_key, hotkey, scroll, screenshot, page. Used by the `operator` expert (Alfred). Needs the `cua-driver` binary on PATH (typically installed to ~/.local/bin; the desktop's child_path() puts that on PATH automatically) + macOS Accessibility permission granted to CuaDriver.app on first use. Spike was Claude-only because Claude inferred the CLI from context; this entry makes it work across every harness (Mistral Vibe, Codex, …).
